channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2025-39964 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

item.title: CVE-2026-20128 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

item.title: CVE-2026-53266 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2023-41992 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2025-39682 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2023-41991 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 54. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability that can allow a malicious app to bypass signature validation.

item.title: CVE-2026-20253 — Splunk Enterprise
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2026-39987 — Marimo Marimo
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-21643 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2025-11953 — React Native Community CLI
item.description: Threat Signal 81. React Native Community CLI contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated network attackers to send POST requests to the Metro Development Server and run arbitrary executables via a vulnerable endpoint exposed by the server. On Windows, attackers can also execute arbitrary shell commands with fully controlled arguments.

item.title: CVE-2023-24955 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker with Site Owner privileges to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2023-27532 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

item.title: CVE-2022-29499 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 81. The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

item.title: CVE-2021-26085 — Atlassian Confluence Server
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Affected versions of Atlassian Confluence Server allow remote attackers to view restricted resources via a pre-authorization arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /s/ endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2021-22941 — Citrix ShareFile
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Improper Access Control in Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller may allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise the storage zones controller.

item.title: CVE-2009-3960 — Adobe BlazeDS
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Adobe BlazeDS, which is utilized in LifeCycle and Coldfusion, contains a vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2019-0752 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 81. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer

item.title: CVE-2021-21975 — VMware vRealize Operations Manager API
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in vRealize Operations Manager API prior to 8.4 may allow a malicious actor with network access to the vRealize Operations Manager API to perform a SSRF attack to steal administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2019-1458 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 81. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory, aka 'Win32k EoP.

item.title: CVE-2018-13382 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 81. An Improper Authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy under SSL VPN web portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to modify the password.

item.title: CVE-2021-40449 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-27104 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to various admin endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2014-1812 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.

item.title: CVE-2020-1472 — Microsoft Netlogon
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of Zerologon.

item.title: CVE-2026-9082 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

item.title: CVE-2026-20182 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2024-7399 — Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files as system authority.

item.title: CVE-2026-34197 — Apache ActiveMQ
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-35616 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-33017 — Langflow Langflow
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

item.title: CVE-2025-68613 — n8n n8n
item.description: Threat Signal 80. n8n contains an improper control of dynamically managed code resources vulnerability in its workflow expression evaluation system that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-20127 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller, formerly SD-WAN vSmart, and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, formerly SD-WAN vManage, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system. This vulnerability exists because the peering authentication mechanism in an affected system is not working properly. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted requests to an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to log in to an affected Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller as an internal, high-privileged, non-root user account. Using this account, the attacker could access NETCONF, which would then allow the attacker to manipulate network configuration for the SD-WAN fabric.

item.title: CVE-2025-49113 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 80. RoundCube Webmail contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote code execution by authenticated users because the _from parameter in a URL is not validated in program/actions/settings/upload.php.

item.title: CVE-2025-37164 — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-61757 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Oracle Fusion Middleware contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to take over Identity Manager.

item.title: CVE-2025-64446 — Fortinet FortiWeb
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Fortinet FortiWeb contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute administrative commands on the system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

item.title: CVE-2025-48703 — CWP Control Web Panel
item.description: Threat Signal 80. CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known.

item.title: CVE-2025-2747 — Kentico Xperience CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Kentico Xperience CMS contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an attacker to control administrative objects.

item.title: CVE-2025-54253 — Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Forms
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Adobe Experience Manager Forms in JEE contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-6278 — GNU GNU Bash
item.description: Threat Signal 80. GNU Bash contains an OS command injection vulnerability which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a crafted environment.

item.title: CVE-2025-25257 — Fortinet FortiWeb
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Fortinet FortiWeb contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized SQL code or commands via crafted HTTP or HTTPs requests.

item.title: CVE-2016-10033 — PHP PHPMailer
item.description: Threat Signal 80. PHPMailer contains a command injection vulnerability because it fails to sanitize user-supplied input. Specifically, this issue affects the 'mail()' function of 'class.phpmailer.php' script. An attacker can exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code within the context of the application. Failed exploit attempts will result in a denial-of-service condition.

item.title: CVE-2025-32433 — Erlang Erlang/OTP
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands without valid credentials, potentially leading to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). By exploiting a flaw in how SSH protocol messages are handled, a malicious actor could gain unauthorized access to affected systems. This vulnerability could affect various products that implement Erlang/OTP SSH server, including—but not limited to—Cisco, NetApp, and SUSE.

item.title: CVE-2021-32030 — ASUS Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. ASUS Lyra Mini and ASUS GT-AC2900 devices contain an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to the administrative interface. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-24813 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache Tomcat contains a path equivalence vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code, disclose information, or inject malicious content via a partial PUT request. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2026‑34486.

item.title: CVE-2024-4885 — Progress WhatsUp Gold
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Progress WhatsUp Gold contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-19410 — Paessler PRTG Network Monitor
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create users with read-write privileges (including administrator).

item.title: CVE-2024-50603 — Aviatrix Controllers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.

item.title: CVE-2024-9463 — Palo Alto Networks Expedition
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary OS commands as root in Expedition, resulting in disclosure of usernames, cleartext passwords, device configurations, and device API keys of PAN-OS firewalls.

item.title: CVE-2019-16278 — Nostromo nhttpd
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Nostromo nhttpd contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the http_verify() function in a non-chrooted nhttpd server allowing for remote code execution.
